title: Djokovic wins five-set epic to set up Sinner semi-final
byline: Novak Djokovic produced an astonishing performance to beat Felix Auger-Aliassime in a five-set thriller lasting over five hours to set up a blockbuster Wimbledon semi-final against defending champion Jannik Sinner.

title: England hammer India in Record-Breaking T20 thrashing
byline: England delivered a ruthless all-round performance to inflict India’s heaviest-ever T20 International defeat, cruising to a commanding 125-run victory in the third T20 at Trent Bridge to move 2-0 up in the five-match series.

title: Series Won! West Indies hold Sri Lanka to draw to end long drought
byline: West Indies secured their first Test series victory in three years after a high-scoring draw against Sri Lanka in the second and final Test at North Sound on Tuesday, clinching the two-match series thanks to their victory in the opener.

title: Opposition MPs wear black bands over prison clash
byline: Opposition MPs attended Parliament wearing black armbands today in protest against what they described as the government’s inadequate response to the clash at Negombo Prison, MP Harsha de Silva told the Daily Mirror.

title: Discontinuing indelible ink could save Rs. 100 million per election: PAFFREL
byline: Discontinuing the use of indelible ink at elections could save nearly Rs. 100 million per election without compromising the integrity of the voting process, Executive Director of the People’s Action for Free and Fair Elections (PAFFREL), Rohana Hettiarachchi, said.

title: House Arrest Act soon to mitigate prison overcrowding: Minister
byline: Highlighting that the root cause of the Negombo Prison clash was tension resulting from severe overcrowding, Justice Minister Harshana Nanayakkara told Parliament that key legal reforms would be introduced, including a House Arrest Bill that would enable remand prisoners to be kept under house arrest subject to electronic monitoring.

title: Iran target US military sites in Kuwait, Bahrain after earlier American strikes
byline: Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said on Wednesday (Jul 8) that they targeted 85 United States military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait, in response to the US’ ’’ceasefire violation’’.

title: Egypt were ‘cheated’ in World Cup loss to Argentina, coach Hassan says
byline: Egypt coach Hossam Hassan claims his side was “cheated” out of a place in the World Cup quarterfinals after Argentina staged a stunning late comeback from 2-0 down to win 3-2 in a gripping last-16 match in Atlanta.

title: Colombo canals turn into garbage dumps despite SLLDC dengue prevention claims
byline: Despite claims by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation (SLLDC) that a special programme is underway to maintain cleanliness in Colombo’s canal system and reduce dengue risks, recent footage has revealed that several canals have become potential breeding grounds for dengue mosquitoes.

title: Government gazettes new Mahamodara Prison
byline: The Minister of Justice and National Integration, Harshana Nanayakkara, has issued an Extraordinary Gazette notification ordering the establishment of a new prison in the Mahamodara area of Galle.

title: Met Dept forecasts showers and strong winds today
byline: Several spells of showers are expected in the Western and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in the Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara Eliya districts today, according to the Department of Meteorology.

title: Acting Prisons Chief describes Negombo Prison clash as ’brutal’ and ’barbaric’
byline: The Acting Commissioner General of Prisons Prasad Hemantha Kumara, has provided harrowing details regarding the violence that unfolded at the Negombo Prison, describing the behaviour of the inmates involved as ’’brutal’’ and ’’barbaric.’’

title: Search under way for cargo plane that vanished off Pakistan coast
byline: Aviation officials in Pakistan say a search operation is ongoing after a cargo plane carrying five crew members went missing off the coast of Karachi, a city at the country’s southern tip.

title: Trump reiterates at NATO summit that Greenland should be controlled by US, not Denmark
byline: President Donald Trump said on Tuesday Greenland should be controlled by ​the United States, not Denmark, reaffirming a stance that has caused tensions among ‌NATO allies just as leaders of the alliance gathered for a summit in Turkey.

title: Rear Admiral Ravindra Tissera appointed as Navy Chief of Staff
byline: Rear Admiral Ravindra Tissera has been appointed as the new Chief of Staff of the Sri Lanka Navy by President Anura Kumara Dissanayake. The Commander of the Navy, Vice Admiral Damian Fernando, formally handed over the letter of appointment to Rear Admiral Tissera at the Navy Headquarters on Monday (7) and extended his best wishes.

title: US launches strikes on Iran after tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz
byline: The US has launched ’’powerful’’ strikes on Iran in response to attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

title: Habitat enrichment programme launched to curb human-elephant conflict
byline: The Environment Ministry, together with the Wildlife Conservation Department and the Forest Conservation Department, has launched the National Programme for Wild Elephant Habitat Enrichment and Rehabilitation, introducing a science-based approach to mitigate Sri Lanka’s long-standing human-elephant conflict.

title: Argentina Stage Stunning Comeback; Switzerland Book Last-Eight Showdown: INFOGRAPHIC
byline: Argentina rallied from two goals down to beat Egypt 3-2, while Switzerland edged Colombia on penalties to set up a quarter-final meeting with the reigning world champions.

title: Digital VAT ambiguity could undermine Sri Lanka’s investment appeal: EY warns
byline: Sri Lanka’s proposed framework to tax digital services could inadvertently raise compliance costs for multinational companies and make the country a more complex market to serve unless authorities provide greater clarity on the new rules, tax experts at EY Sri Lanka have cautioned.

title: Former SEC chief slams banking sector and professionals over SME neglect
byline: Former Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Chairman Ranel T. Wijesinha sharply criticised the banking sector, the accounting profession, and corporate entities for their collective failure to support small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in accessing the capital market.

title: Online marketplaces require clarity on VAT calculations
byline: A separate issue emerging from Sri Lanka’s proposed digital VAT regime is how tax authorities will determine the value on which VAT should be charged when transactions are facilitated through online platforms.

title: AI-generated women on Facebook used to lure Sri Lankan users into scams, adult chats
byline: A network of AI-generated female profiles on Facebook is being used to create fake identities, attract users through emotional and sexualised content, and redirect them towards adult-chat services, gambling platforms, cryptocurrency promotions and other questionable online destinations, according to a study by researcher Dr. Sanjana Hattotuwa.

title: Stipulated fares for buses, three-wheelers, office and school vans: Minister
byline: A new system of stipulated fares for buses, three wheelers, school vans and office vans will be introduced soon, Minister of Transport Bimal Ratnayake told Parliament today.

title: US reinstates sanctions on Iranian oil sales after LNG, oil tanker attacks
byline: The United ‌States on Tuesday re-imposed sanctions on Iranian oil, as a U.S. official warned that Iran’s attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz were ’’wholly unacceptable’’ and would be met with consequences.

title: Two transferred inmates die after Negombo Prison unrest
byline: Two inmates transferred from Negombo Prison following the recent unrest have died.

title: Adam Bobrow, the 'Voice of Table Tennis,' takes on Sri Lanka
byline: Adam Bobrow, the American commentator and YouTuber known as ’’The Voice of Table Tennis,’’ recently visited Sri Lanka to take on 15 of the country’s best players in a single sitting, filmed at the High Performance Table Tennis Academy.

title: Former Minister Jagath Pushpakumara arrested
byline: Former Cabinet Minister Jagath Pushpakumara was arrested today by officers of the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) over several alleged corruption offences.

title: Sugeeshwara Bandara further remanded
byline: Colombo Fort Magistrate Pasan Amarasena today ordered former President Gotabaya Rajapaksa’s former Private Secretary, Sugeeshwara Lenin Bandara, to be further remanded till July 22 over allegations of criminal misappropriation of funds allocated under the Presidential Expenditure Head.

title: Ultimate objective should be to make public transport free of charge: Minister
byline: The ultimate goal pertaining to transportation is to make public transport free of charge and keep private vehicles home. However, it cannot be done now, Minister of Transport Bimal Ratnayake told Parliament today.

title: Tinea infections on the rise in Sri Lanka
byline: Health authorities have warned of a sharp rise in skin disease cases across Sri Lanka, with tinea (ringworm) emerging as one of the most commonly reported fungal skin infections.

title: ‘Silicon City’ industrial park planned in Nattandiya
byline: The Government is planning to establish a modern silicon-based industrial park named “Silicone City” in the Nattandiya area, utilising the silica sand deposits found in the Nattandiya Mahawewa–Horakelle Wattha farm belonging to the National Livestock Development Board (NLDB).

title: Prison officials seek Minister’s protection for officer who opened fire
byline: Prison officials have urged Justice Minister Harshana Nanayakkara to protect the prison officer who opened fire during the recent unrest at Negombo Prison, claiming that misleading information is being circulated about his actions.

title: CPRP alleges torture of transferred Negombo Prison inmates
byline: The Committee for Protecting Rights of Prisoners (CPRP) has called for an immediate end to the alleged torture of inmates transferred from Negombo Prison to other correctional facilities following recent unrest.

title: Dengue death toll rises to 42
byline: The number of dengue-related deaths reported in Sri Lanka so far this year has climbed to 42, the National Dengue Control Unit (NDCU) said.

title: Bus plunges into stream near Gregory Lake
byline: A private bus overturned into the Thalagala Oya near Gregory Lake in Nuwara Eliya today after the driver reportedly lost control while attempting to park the vehicle.

title: Special police protection for 454 persons
byline: Special police protection is being provided to 454 persons, including former MPs, former IGPs, retired judges, chief incumbent monks of several temples, a Bishop and a former First Lady, Parliament was informed yesterday.

title: Locally made firearm to scare animals out in the market
byline: A locally made firearm turned out by a young man in the Wellawaya area to scare giant squirrels, monkeys and macaques causing crop devastation was sold in Badulla town to the public.

title: Dengue vaccine has 90% effectiveness against type 2 virus – Expert
byline: Consultant Paediatrician and Founder Clinical Head of the Centre for Clinical Management of Dengue & Dengue Haemorrhagic Fever in Negombo, Dr. Lakkumar Fernando, said an internationally approved dengue vaccine could significantly reduce the burden of the disease as it has more than 90% effectiveness against dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2).

title: Health Ministry warns nursing officers of transfer scams
byline: The Health and Mass Media Ministry has warned nursing officers against a suspected racket involving the collection of personal information and money from officers seeking annual transfers for 2026.

title: Employment barriers continue to limit workforce participation of persons with disabilities, says ChildFund
byline: Sri Lanka is losing productivity, talent and economic potential by failing to better integrate persons with disabilities into the workforce, ChildFund Sri Lanka warns. While nearly 70 percent of persons with disabilities remain unemployed despite persistent labour shortages across industries, this group includes many people who could participate in the labour market with appropriate support,

title: Ad hoc rice imports blamed for growing paddy marketing crisis
byline: The flooding of the domestic market with imported rice ahead of the harvesting season has triggered the current crisis in the paddy marketing sector, according to analysts.

title: Remains of prison officers killed in clash brought to Welikada
byline: The remains of the prison officers who lost their lives in the violent clash at the Negombo Prison were brought to the Welikada Prison premises in a motorcade this morning (08).

title: Govt considers social media ban for children under-16: PM
byline: The government is considering banning or limiting social media access to children under 16, Prime Minister Harini Amarasuriya told Parliament today.

title: Government committed to preparing children for technology-driven future: PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya said the Government is committed to equipping Sri Lanka’s children with modern technology, knowledge and skills required to face the challenges of the future.

title: Four buses seized for running on kerosene fuel
byline: Four passenger transport buses have been taken into custody by the Ambalangoda Police for allegedly operating using kerosene as fuel instead of diesel.

title: Greaves, Fernando gain in ICC men’s test player rankings
byline: All-rounder Justin Greaves of the West Indies and seam bowler Asitha Fernando of Sri Lanka have made notable gains in the ICC Men’s Test Player Rankings after the drawn second match of their ICC World Test Championship series in North Sound, Saint George, Antigua and Barbuda.

title: Trump says interim accord to end war is ’over’ after Iranian strikes
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said ​an interim agreement to end the war with Iran ​was ’’over’’ on Wednesday after Tehran carried out new ⁠attacks on U.S. bases in the Gulf.

title: Govt plans to clear major elephant corridors in Anuradhapura
byline: The government has decided to expedite the clearing and protection of key elephant corridors in the Anuradhapura District as part of its long-term strategy to reduce the human-elephant conflict.

title: Trump says at NATO summit he has ordered cutoff of US trade with Spain
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday at a NATO summit he had ordered his ​Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to cut off all ‌trade with Spain, calling Madrid a ’’terrible partner’’ in the alliance.

title: Death toll reaches 28 in Negombo Prison clash
byline: A prison guard who was admitted to the Colombo National Hospital with severe injuries following the violent clashes at the Negombo Prison has passed away.

title: If the system had changed, the Minister would have stepped down – Namal Rajapaksa
byline: MP Namal Rajapaksa, National Organizer of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP), Namal Rajapaksa, said the government’s response to the Negombo prison tragedy demonstrates that the promised “system change” has failed, arguing that true accountability would have required the subject minister to resign.

title: CID completes probe into case against Ranil Wickremesinghe over London trip allegations
byline: The Criminal Investigation Department today informed Fort Magistrate Pasan Amarasena that it has concluded all investigations into the case filed against former President Ranil Wickremesinghe over allegations that he caused a loss of more than Rs. 16 million to the State.

title: Several parties seek to intervene in Suresh Sallay’s writ petition
byline: Several individuals and organisations, including prominent Buddhist monks, have sought the permission of the Court of Appeal to intervene in the writ application filed by Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay, former Director of the State Intelligence Service, challenging the legality of his arrest and detention.

title: New Era Begins? West Indies build on historic series win over Sri Lanka
byline: West Indies ended a wait of more than two decades for a Test series victory over Sri Lanka, sealing a memorable 1-0 triumph and raising hopes of a new era under captain Roston Chase.

title: German doctor jailed for killing 15 of his patients
byline: A German palliative care doctor has been sentenced to life imprisonment for killing 15 of his patients

title: Trump threatens to hit Iran ’hard again tonight’ after saying ceasefire ’is over’
byline: US President Donald Trump today (Wednesday 8) gave Iran a ’’warning’’ and said that the United States will strike the Islamic Republic ’’very hard’’ tonight. He also stated that he was unhappy with Iran, hours after declaring that the ceasefire was over following attacks on American military sites in the Gulf.

title: 239 drivers, conductors test positive for drugs in Western Province
byline: A total of 239 drivers and conductors have tested positive for prohibited drugs under a mobile drug screening programme carried out in the Western Province, the National Institute of Transport Medicine said today.

title: CSE declines further as geopolitical concerns weigh on investor sentiment
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange extended its decline on Wednesday, with both benchmark indices closing lower as escalating tensions in the Middle East continued to weigh on investor confidence.

title: Egypt want officials kicked out of World Cup
byline: The Egyptian Football Association says it has asked Fifa to kick the officials in charge of their World Cup last-16 defeat by Argentina out of the tournament.

title: ’’Water Supply Disconnection Week’’ programme cancelled: NWSDB
byline: The National Water Supply and Drainage Board (NWSDB) has announced that the ’’Water Supply Disconnection Week’’ programme, which was scheduled to be carried out from July 13 to 19, 2026, has been cancelled.

title: Kandy Esala Perahera to begin with ’Kap’ planting ceremony on August 13
byline: The annual Esala Perahera of the historic Sri Dalada Maligawa will begin with the traditional ’’Kap’’ planting ceremony, or ’’Kap Situweema,’’ on August 13 at 6.17 a.m., Diyawadana Nilame Pradeep Nilanga Dela said.

title: Education institutions to strengthen inclusive education framework
byline: The Education Ministry and several government institutions will work together to integrate inclusive education into future plans, following a workshop held in Colombo on promoting research findings related to inclusive education.

title: Warm weather advisory issued for three districts
byline: The Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre of the Meteorology Department has issued a warm weather advisory for the Batticaloa, Ampara and Monaragala districts, warning that the heat index could reach “Caution” level in some areas during the daytime tomorrow (09).

title: Housing aid programme planned for low-income families with unfinished homes
byline: The Government is planning a housing assistance programme to help low-income families complete partially constructed houses, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said.

title: Government must reconsider northern train service cuts ahead of the Nallur Kandaswamy Temple Festival – Cassilingam
byline: SLPP Jaffna District Organizer and Politburo Member Geethanath Cassilingam has called on the government to immediately reconsider its decision to reduce the Colombo–Kankesanthurai Intercity Express service, warning that the move would cause significant inconvenience to thousands of passengers travelling to the North ahead of the Nallur Kandaswamy Temple Festival.

title: Sri Lanka ranks 83rd globally in Claude AI usage, new data shows
byline: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI chatbot, tracks how people around the world use its models through what it calls the Anthropic Economic Index. The Index breaks down usage by country, by occupation, and by task type, using data pulled from Claude.ai conversations.

title: 2027 Budget to prioritise long-term solutions for drinking water issues
byline: The 2027 Budget would give special priority to addressing the country’s long-standing drinking water issues by introducing sustainable solutions, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake said.

title: Online pension awareness sessions for retiring officers
byline: The Pensions Department will launch a special online awareness session series from tomorrow (09) aimed at reducing delays in granting pensions to retiring public officers.

title: Paddy Marketing Board to begin Yala paddy purchases on July 15
byline: The Paddy Marketing Board (PMB) will commence purchasing paddy from the 2026 Yala season harvest from July 15, following instructions to begin procurement without delay.

title: Russia tries to jam Musk’s Starlink systems to counter Ukrainian drones
byline: Russian forces are trying to counter Ukrainian ’’mid-strike’’ drone attacks by camouflaging cargoes and installing powerful jamming systems to disrupt Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite internet system, Ukrainian drone commanders and pilots told ​Reuters.

title: New US attacks on Iran were absolutely necessary, NATO chief says
byline: The new attacks by the U.S. on Iran were ’’absolutely necessary,’’ ​NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said on Wednesday.

title: New Foreign Employment Act soon – Minister
byline: A new Foreign Employment Act aimed at addressing existing legal gaps and strengthening the rights and security of Sri Lankans working overseas will be presented to Parliament soon, Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism Minister Vijitha Herath said today.

title: Kitulgala jewellery shop owner fined Rs. 2.1 mn for illegal wildlife trade
byline: A suspect arrested by wildlife officers for illegally possessing and selling protected animal parts at a jewellery establishment in the tourist town of Kitulgala has been fined Rs. 2.1 million after pleading guilty to 38 charges.
